The petitioners are figuring as accused in CC.No.54 of 2010 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate No.I, Madurai for the offences under Sections 16(1)(a)(i) and (ii) r/w 7(i)(v) and (a) and (m) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and Rule 50(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955 and 7(i) 16(1)(a) (1) r/w Section 2(1a) (a) (i) and 2(ix) (k) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2.In this case, food sample was seized on 04.06.2009.
The report of the Public Analyst was received on 06.7.2009.
But, notice was served on the petitioners only on 02.03.2010.
Thus, there has been a lapse of a clear eight months in the process.
Therefore, the petitioners have been deprived of the valuable right of re-analysis.
In similar circumstance, the prosecution was quashed by this Court in the decision reported in (2011) 3 MLJ (Crl) 99 (T.R.S.Vijayaraj v. Commissioner).
The facts of this case are absolutely similar.
3.Following the aforesaid decision, the proceedings impugned in this petition are quashed.
This Criminal Original Petition is allowed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
To Food Inspector, Madurai Corporation, Madurai.
